records.boundary: EcoLogits video-generation model, provider, hardware-power, hardware-embodied-impact, capability, and latency-regression inputs
records.geography: Provider-specific defaults: USA or Singapore, depending on model provider
records.scenario_role: Source lower and upper machine-power bounds; calculator central scenario will be their midpoint
records.derivation: Byte-identical copy from the pinned EcoLogits release; no coefficients transformed
records.limitations: Some proprietary-model regressions are extrapolations; provider hardware, location, PUE, and WUE can be assumptions. The method attributes the whole assigned machine to a request. See EcoLogits warnings and methodology before display.

records.boundary: EcoLogits electricity-generation GWP, primary-energy, abiotic-depletion, and water-consumption factors by geographic zone
records.geography: Worldwide country and region table; video provider defaults currently resolve to USA or Singapore
records.scenario_role: Provider-location operational carbon and electricity-generation water factors
records.derivation: Byte-identical copy from the pinned EcoLogits release; no coefficients transformed
records.limitations: Geographic factors are averages and some zones use world defaults with warnings. They do not identify an individual request's actual data-center electricity supply.

records.boundary: RTX 4090 workstation electricity measured during generation for 17 open diffusion models and three tested resolutions
records.source_title: The Hidden Cost of an Image: Quantifying the Energy Consumption of AI Image Generation
records.geography: Not used for carbon conversion; energy was measured on one RTX 4090 workstation
records.scenario_role: Pending per-model, per-resolution lower, median, and upper source values
records.derivation: Not transcribed. The arXiv package contains figures but no machine-readable observation table, and chart-pixel digitization would introduce inferred coefficients prohibited by the specification.
records.limitations: The paper reports more than 9,000 measurements and an overall all-setting model-median span of 0.000086–0.00408 kWh/image, but those summary values cannot populate the required 17-by-3 table. Image calculations must remain disabled until exact companion data are obtained.
